author: agent:codex

body.review_follow_up: PR #21: fixed exact-8-KiB procfs EOF detection and reject oversized records as unavailable samples; added UTF-8 small-batch rotation-boundary regression test. All 16 focused tests, check (246 application + 3 metric tests), build and 11 integration tests pass. Both concerns classified fix; historical full measurements remain attributed to 8a0d5d0.
body.summary: Three full resource repetitions pass unchanged baseline-relative RSS/CPU/growth limits after procfs-buffer reuse and batched log writes: post-cycle RSS 109.8-122.4 MiB and growth 15.75-28.75 MiB, versus 166.7-171.4 MiB and 56.47-60.25 MiB before. A 128 MiB retained-memory negative control fails both memory checks with graceful cleanup. Check/build, 11 integration, 5 UI and 2 real E2E tests pass on implementation 8a0d5d0 incorporating PR #20. Owner workflow and sustained slow-disk overflow remain outside this evidence.

title: Controller resource budget, measurements and bounded process inspection
